description: Source code implementing MIPS DSP R2 optimized convolution functions for the Skia graphics library, including horizontal and vertical convolution routines with inline assembly for performance.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally_mips_dspr2
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution along a single row using MIPS DSP R2 instructions with inline assembly, optimized for images with alpha channel.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically_mips_dspr2
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution across multiple rows using MIPS DSP R2 instructions with inline assembly, optimized for images with alpha channel.
